mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_wecom_groupchat_daily ( corp_id, owner_userid, owner_name, stat_time, new_chat_cnt, chat_total, chat_has_msg, new_member_cnt, member_total, member_has_msg, msg_total, migrate_trainee_chat_cnt, raw_json, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{corpId}, #{ownerUserid}, #{ownerName}, #{statTime}, #{newChatCnt}, #{chatTotal}, #{chatHasMsg}, #{newMemberCnt}, #{memberTotal}, #{memberHasMsg}, #{msgTotal}, #{migrateTraineeChatCnt}, #{rawJson}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON CONFLICT (owner_userid, stat_time) DO UPDATE SET corp_id = EXCLUDED.corp_id, owner_name = EXCLUDED.owner_name, new_chat_cnt = EXCLUDED.new_chat_cnt, chat_total = EXCLUDED.chat_total, chat_has_msg = EXCLUDED.chat_has_msg, new_member_cnt = EXCLUDED.new_member_cnt, member_total = EXCLUDED.member_total, member_has_msg = EXCLUDED.member_has_msg, msg_total = EXCLUDED.msg_total, migrate_trainee_chat_cnt = EXCLUDED.migrate_trainee_chat_cnt, raw_json = EXCLUDED.raw_json, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT owner_userid AS userid, MAX(owner_name) AS name FROM crm_wecom_groupchat_daily GROUP BY owner_userid
